newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan keeping contact with Asia govts on forex - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan keeping contact with Asia govts on forex - MOF.

text.p: Japan will keep close contact with other Asian economies such as Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand for the stability of currency markets in the region, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.
"It is an important role for Japan as a nation within the Asian economic region to keep close contact with other countries," Mitsuzuka told a regular news conference.
"We are doing that right now and we will keep contact and exchange information. But that does not necessarily mean we are in a special cooperative alliance," he said.

Mitsuzuka said the currency turmoil in the Philippine peso, the Indonesian rupiah and the Malaysian ringgit seemed to be settling down. On the Thai baht he reiterated a statement by the ministry last week that Japan will keep close contact with Thai authorities and cooperate in markets as necessary for the stabilisation of the baht.
